archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Archetype 5 (Luxury) for a Clean Minimal Arcane-Tech blend
design_philosophy: ADHD-friendly, calm focus, low clutter, high contrast. One clear focal action per screen. Futuristic RPG meets minimalist IDE. No shame-based feedback, small wins.

headings.description: Clean, geometric, futuristic without being cheesy. High legibility.

mono.description: For AI lab console, JSON output, and debugging puzzles.

display.description: Used sparingly for Boss Battles and Level Up screens for that arcane-tech punch.

usage.backgrounds: Use --bg-base for main app background, --bg-surface for cards. Avoid pure black.
usage.text: Never use pure white. Use --text-primary for headings, --text-secondary for body.
usage.accents: Use --accent-arcane (Amber) for primary actions (Play, Next, Run Agent). Use --accent-plasma (Cyan) for secondary tech indicators (Memory, Tools).

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0C]/80 border-t border-white/10 z-50

depth_and_visuals.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/5 for overlays, modals, and sticky headers. Must include 1px border-white/10.
depth_and_visuals.grain_texture: Apply a subtle SVG noise filter (opacity 15-20%) over the main background to reduce digital harshness.
depth_and_visuals.glows: Use sparingly. Drop-shadow with accent color only on active buttons or current level node (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.4)]).
depth_and_visuals.borders: 1px solid border-white/5 or border-white/10 for cards. No heavy borders.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#0A0A0C] font-semibold rounded-lg py-4 px-6 active:scale-95 transition-transform shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-lg py-4 px-6 active:bg-white/5

cards.mission_card: bg-[#121316] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 relative overflow-hidden
cards.flip_card: relative w-full h-64 perspective-1000 (implement via framer-motion 3D flip)
cards.lab_console: bg-black rounded-lg border border-[#2EC4B6]/20 p-4 font-mono text-sm overflow-auto text-slate-300

campaign_map.style: Vertical scrolling list or grid of nodes connected by glowing SVG lines.
campaign_map.node_locked: w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-2 border-white/10 bg-[#121316] flex items-center justify-center opacity-50
campaign_map.node_active: w-20 h-20 rounded-full border-2 border-[#F59E0B] bg-[#1A1C23] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.4)] relative
campaign_map.node_completed: w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-2 border-[#2EC4B6] bg-[#121316] flex items-center justify-center

skill_tree.style: Bento grid layout for branches. Hexagonal or diamond-shaped nodes for tech/arcane feel.
skill_tree.progress_rings: SVG circular progress indicators with stroke-[#2EC4B6] for tech skills, stroke-[#F59E0B] for arcane/prompting skills.

hud_elements.xp_bar: h-2 w-full bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden. Inner bar: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F59E0B] to-yellow-300
hud_elements.streak_badge: Flex row, flame icon (amber), bold text, subtle bg-[#F59E0B]/10 rounded-full px-3 py-1

default.page_transition: framer-motion opacity-0 y-4 to opacity-100 y-0 duration-300 ease-out
default.micro_interactions: scale down to 0.95 on tap for buttons and cards

reduced_motion.micro_interactions: disable scaling, use background color change for active state

accessibility.adhd_focus: One primary CTA per screen. Dim out or blur background elements when a task is active. Use 'Focus Mode' (hides nav and XP bar during lab sessions).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA against dark backgrounds. Avoid gray-on-gray for essential info.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-mission-btn').

campaign_map.description: Minimalist starry night map for the campaign background. Dark overlay required (bg-black/80).

boss_battle.description: Dark geometric polyhedron for the boss arena background. Use with heavy vignette.

lab_texture.description: Abstract dark geometry for the AI Engineering Lab backdrop. Keep opacity at 10%.

media.icons_strategy: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) or Lucide-React. Keep stroke width consistent.
